basics.Brand Positioning: Boutique lifestyle hotels with personality—design-forward, guest-centric, and unscripted. Pet-friendly hotels known for thoughtful F&B, social wine hour, and local character in gateway and resort markets.
basics.Brand Customer Promise: A boutique stay that feels personal, playful, and rooted in the neighborhood—without sacrificing IHG scale, loyalty, and revenue tools.
basics.Brand Value Proposition: Kimpton gives owners access to IHG's distribution, IHG One Rewards, and revenue infrastructure while preserving a distinct lifestyle product that commands premium ADR in urban and resort conversions.
basics.Brand Pillars: Design & local character; heartfelt service; F&B and social spaces; pet-friendly policy; IHG One Rewards integration
basics.Key Brand Differentiators: Lifestyle boutique positioning within IHG; strong conversion story for independent and soft-brand assets; wine hour and restaurant-forward guest experience; pet-stay program; design flexibility relative to rigid select-service flags.
basics.Brand History: Founded in San Francisco in 1981; joined IHG in 2015. Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants franchises upper-upscale lifestyle hotels in North America and select international markets, with growth emphasis on conversions and design-led renovations.
basics.Target Guest Segments: Experience-led leisure and business travelers; design-conscious guests; urban professionals; pet owners; group and social F&B patrons
basics.Guest Psychographics Description: Guests who value personality over predictability—willing to pay a premium for neighborhood authenticity, distinctive design, and social hotel experiences.
basics.Sustainability Positioning: Participates in IHG Journey to Tomorrow commitments; property-level programs vary by asset and jurisdiction.
basics.Explorer Hero Data Source: IHG development brochures, kimptonhotels.com, Kimpton FDD 2024 (MN filing) — human review required before external use.

Brand Setup - Fee Structure.Additional Notes - Typical Application F: $500/guest room, minimum $100,000. Partial refund if application withdrawn before approval (less $15,000). Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote. Illustrative 200-room total investment about $325,352–$457,585/key excluding land.
Brand Setup - Fee Structure.Additional Notes - Typical Royalty Fee R: 6% on gross room revenue plus 1% on gross food and beverage sales. Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
Brand Setup - Fee Structure.Additional Notes - Typical Marketing Fee: Services contribution 3% of gross room revenue in aggregate (marketing and reservations-related fees). Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
Brand Setup - Fee Structure.Additional Notes - Typical Loyalty Progr: IHG One Rewards assessments: 4.55% qualifying full-folio revenue and 1.365% qualifying room and meeting revenue. Model net after chargebacks. Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
Brand Setup - Fee Structure.Additional Notes - Typical Tech: Technology services fee about $17.06/room/month plus other mandatory IHG systems (PMS, CRS, digital, Wi‑Fi). Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
Brand Setup - Fee Structure.Additional Notes - Typical Training Fee: Pre-opening support about $20,000–$35,000; department-head certification about $40,000–$60,000; IHG Learning Program about $5,500/year. Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.
Brand Setup - Fee Structure.Typical Incentives Offered: Key money, fee ramps, and conversion co-investment may be available in competitive gateway markets—deal-specific.
Brand Setup - Fee Structure.Typical Termination Fee Structure (if an: Termination with cause may trigger liquidated damages—review cure periods and exit framework with counsel.
Brand Setup - Fee Structure.Typical Expectations for Owner-Funded Re: FF&E, capital reserve (up to 5% of gross revenue may apply), and public-space reserves typical for upper-upscale lifestyle conversions.
Brand Setup - Fee Structure.Additional Notes - Typical Reservation /: GDS fee about $6.40/reservation; IHG Ignite digital marketing commission about 2.25% on qualifying consumed revenue. Confirm in your countersigned franchise disclosure document—not a property-specific quote.

Brand Setup - Deal Terms.Renewal Structure: No automatic renewal — re-licensing may be offered
Brand Setup - Deal Terms.Typical Renewal Conditions: Initial license term is 20 years for new development and 10 years for conversions; change-of-ownership/re-licensing typically 10 years. Brand Setup - Deal Terms.Typical Cure Period for Performance Test: Cure periods apply to QA, fee, and reporting defaults—confirm with counsel.
